_README: REAL MEASUREMENTS ONLY. Nothing in this file may be estimated, interpolated,
extrapolated from another model, or derived from a parameter count. If a number was
not produced by running or building the actual artifact, it does not belong here —
leave it absent so consumers correctly report 'unmeasured'.
Written by hardware_eval/measure_model.py; read by config/android_pool.py.
_sizes: on-disk weight bytes of a real build, keyed '<model_id>|<quant|bf16>'.
Chip-independent. Overrides the bytes-per-parameter arithmetic in _variant().
and never shared across chips or quants. Fields (all optional, omit if not
measured): peak_memory_mb (peak RSS), tok_per_s (sustained decode), ttft_ms,
avg_watts. Each entry must carry 'source', 'method', and 'measured_at'.

2026-07-29 (slurm job 37905779).result: The bytes-per-parameter arithmetic is WELL CALIBRATED after the Qwen3.5-4B correction: measured vs predicted is +4.7..+4.9% for Q4_K_M and bf16, and -1.1% for Q8_0, uniformly across every family.
2026-07-29 (slurm job 37905779).interpretation: A negative result worth keeping. The earlier '20% low' on Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M was real AT THE TIME and was fixed by raising the Q4_K_M constant to 0.55 bytes/param; this sweep confirms that correction generalizes to every other family rather than being specific to the 4B. No variant changes tier, so the pool's ordering and every hardware gate were already correct.
2026-07-29 (slurm job 37905779).residual_bias: Q4_K_M and bf16 run ~4.8% light, Q8_0 ~1.1% heavy. Both are well inside the 250-750 MB tier bands, which is why nothing moved.
2026-07-29 (slurm job 37905779).not_measured: Runtime metrics (peak RSS, tok/s, TTFT) — llama-cli is not on the venv PATH (only llama-quantize is). These stay absent, so consumers correctly report 'unmeasured' rather than trusting a guess.
